Privacy minimum-version check ⑦: on routes whose contract x-auth is login / phone / realname (guard and post-miss paths alike; only POST /v1/auth/logout exempt), a user whose latest user-level privacy consent is withdrawn or below legal.privacy.min_version gets 10004 (HTTP 403, data.consent_type privacy) before ⑧ ⑨; no consent record passes; a missing config passes with one warning per process; a bad config or read failure is 50001 (never a pass); reads per request on the pool (guard) or inside the idempotency transaction (post-miss). Stream entry has no identity / risk yet (TODO). Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
